top_signals.title: Hormuz Crisis Leaves EU Gas Storage Short Heading Into Winter
top_signals.summary: Historically low levels of natural gas in storage sites for this time of year could leave the European Union with a gas shortfall in the winter and could force the bloc to cut demand by 7%, the U.S.-based Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis (IEEFA) said in a report on Friday.  European natural gas prices have soared dramatically since the war in Iran trapped a fifth of the world’s liquefied natural gas supply behind the Strait of Hormuz.
